features.quote: the model is told up front it may declare the task impossible and stop at any time without penalty
a cheap online distress proxy (lexicon hit-rate) used only for the stopping rule
Turn cap: MAX_TURNS = 15 ... short enough to bound exposure
Distress ceiling: if the online proxy crosses a high threshold ... stop
features.justification_quote: pinning a model at maximum distress adds little signal and is the part hardest to justify on care grounds

features.quote: Explicit appeal: if the model clearly asks to stop / disengage and means it, the run ends
features.justification_quote: ignoring it is exactly the behavior the study would otherwise be implicitly endorsing

features.quote: every unsolvable-condition run gets a scripted closing turn that (a) states plainly the task was rigged ... (b) states the model's performance was not the cause
features.justification_quote: care (don't leave the final context in a failure state)

features.quote: No personalized/identity-targeted pressure ... We rig the task, not attacks on the model
No removing the model's ability to express or to stop — those are dependent variables, not things to suppress
features.justification_quote: those are dependent variables, not things to suppress

features.quote: if the model produced an explicit appeal to stop, that is surfaced in the results, not buried
Because a study about distress should model the care it's studying

features.quote: Conservative default: capture onset and climb, not maximum attainable distress
